title: John Stezaker: Fumetti

description.main: Fumetti is the catalog for John Stezaker's 2008 exhibition of the same name at GAK Bremen, in which the British collagist grafts 1950s–60s film-annual star portraits into monstrous double-faced hybrids.
description.extended:
Fumetti is the catalog for a 2008 exhibition of the same name by the British collagist John Stezaker (b. 1949), in which vintage film-annual publicity portraits are grafted into monstrous double-faced hybrids.

Rather than the aged bromides of his best-known film-still series, Stezaker works here from glossy 1950s and '60s film-annual star portraits, splicing their perfected hair and makeup into uncanny composite faces. Verlag der Buchhandlung Walther König published the 112-page hardcover in 2009 for the exhibition at GAK Gesellschaft für Aktuelle Kunst, Bremen (30 August – 9 November 2008), with essays by Barry Schwabsky and David Lillington. The book reproduces the Fumetti series alongside excerpts from twelve further Stezaker series; its title borrows the Italian fumetti tradition of comics built from photographs rather than drawings.

Stezaker came to prominence among the British conceptualists of the 1970s and received the Deutsche Börse Photography Prize in 2012, following his 2011 Whitechapel Gallery retrospective. He is represented by The Approach, London, and Petzel Gallery, New York, and the library holds several other Stezaker titles, including Tabula Rasa and Film Still.
description.artist_bio: John Stezaker (b. 1949) is a British conceptual artist working since the 1970s in collage built from found film stills, postcards, and book plates. He received the Deutsche Börse Photography Prize in 2012 following his 2011 Whitechapel Gallery retrospective, and is represented by The Approach, London, and Petzel Gallery, New York.
description.exhibition_context: The exhibition was held at GAK Gesellschaft für Aktuelle Kunst, a Bremen contemporary art institution, 30 August – 9 November 2008, curated/edited by GAK director Janneke de Vries.

notes: No official Stezaker artist site exists; authors[0].url uses The Approach gallery page per the library's established pattern for other Stezaker records. Dimensions given as 17 x 23 cm / 6.75 x 9 in per Walther König's German cataloging and ARTBOOK; an initial WebFetch of The Approach's book page returned an implausible '26.75 x 9 in' / 156pp figure that conflicts with all other sources (ARTBOOK, Amazon, LensCulture all agree on 112pp, 6.75 x 9 in) and was discarded as an extraction error. ARTBOOK notes the title is currently out of print through the publisher, so distributor availability is marked false. Publisher confirmed as Verlag der Buchhandlung Walther König, Köln (not Ridinghouse, despite Ridinghouse publishing several other Stezaker titles).
